scope: Gist account-based post listing: fetching public Gists from a configured GitHub account.
Slug-based post URLs and routing: mapping filenames to slugs (e.g. `hello-world.md` → `hello-world`).
Post list and post detail rendering: homepage list with links and post detail Markdown rendering.
Environment configuration: single `GIST_ACCOUNT` variable; removal/deprecation of Gist ID configuration.
Error and edge cases: empty account, unknown slug (404), typecheck/lint.
environmentData: **Environment:** `GIST_ACCOUNT` (or equivalent) must be configurable for tests; use a test account or mocked API.
**API:** GitHub Gists API; tests should mock `GET /users/{username}/gists` and Gist file fetch to avoid network dependency.
**Fixtures:** Mock Gist response payloads for list and file content; empty list for no-Gists scenario.
## User Story: US-001 - List posts from Gist account

automatedTests.description: Env variable `GIST_ACCOUNT` (or equivalent) is read and used when fetching Gists
Gist fetcher calls `GET /users/{username}/gists` with the account from config
Slug derivation converts first filename to slug (e.g. `hello-world.md` → `hello-world`)
Homepage renders a list of posts with links to `/posts/[slug]`
Account with no public Gists shows empty list, no error
Each list item includes post metadata (title/filename, date if available)
Gist list is fetched server-side (not client-side)
Typecheck and lint pass for Gist list feature
No Gist ID env variable required; account-based fetch used
Post page fetches Gist content for slug and renders as Markdown
Slug correctly maps to Gist file (filename without extension → slug)
Homepage links to `/posts/[slug]` resolve to correct post content
Typecheck and lint pass for post detail feature

exploratoryManualTests.description: Visual layout and spacing of post list look correct
Visual rendering of Markdown (headings, code blocks, links) looks correct
